basis: NVIDIA’s August 24 earnings release explicitly forecast consolidated revenue of $5.90 billion ±2% for Q3 FY2023, the quarter ending October 30, 2022. The high end was $6,018,000,000. That was below $6,747,850,000, or 95% of Q3 FY2022 reported GAAP revenue of $7,103,000,000. The earlier August 8 warning quantified only Q2 revenue.

coverage.detail: May 25, preceding earnings cycle. The $8.10 billion ±2% revenue outlook applied to Q2 FY2023, the quarter ending July 31.

The Q1 investor presentation identified regional Gaming weakness and an upcoming product transition. It gave no bounded Q3 FY2023 consolidated revenue forecast. Its historical revenue chart showed the $7,103 million Q3 FY2022 comparison was already public.

August 8 preliminary release. The $6.70 billion estimate covered the quarter ended July 31. Management expected difficult channel conditions to persist into Q3 and scheduled its outlook discussion for August 24. The Q3 remarks supplied no company-wide revenue ceiling.

August 24 CFO commentary, Exhibit 99.2, independently identifies Q3 FY2023 and repeats the $5.90 billion ±2% company-wide forecast. It discusses Gaming, Professional Visualization, Data Center and Automotive separately as drivers of that total.
NVIDIA’s newsroom dates the qualifying Q2 release August 24. Its Outlook section explicitly identifies Q3 FY2023 as the forecast quarter.
EDGAR records acceptance of the 8-K containing the earnings release and CFO commentary on August 24 at 16:24:34.

August 31 export-license disclosure. NVIDIA explicitly referred back to its August 24 Q3 outlook and said it included about $400 million of potential China sales exposed to licensing risk. It gave no revised consolidated range.
September 1 follow-up. NVIDIA described export authorizations for H100 development and specified operations, with no revised consolidated revenue forecast.

November 16 actual release. For the quarter ended October 30, the GAAP revenue row shows $5,931 million for Q3 FY2023 and $7,103 million for Q3 FY2022. The consolidated income statement gives the same comparison.

publication_date_evidence: NVIDIA’s newsroom displays August 24, 2022 on the release containing the Q3 forecast. The SEC-hosted Exhibit 99.1 bears the same dateline, and EDGAR records the corresponding 8-K as public that day.
